combinations.preload_curve_scale_ml: the same: lambda is identifiable only as lambda / kappa
combinations.reserve: with the GI arrival band re-anchored, only reserve x arrival_delivery_ratio reaches D and the deficit (P2I-2P); alone it moves only the ADEQUATE / COMPENSATED label
combinations.volume_preload_kappa: only lambda / kappa reaches output, pressure and delivery (V enters only as V / lambda); Hb never reads kappa

CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT.authoring: optional per case: a new authoring field (rate or severity grade) plus a registered mapping from severity to rate; the family default must be approved once
CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT.clinical: cases can differ (brisk versus slow bleeding) where their authors say so; undeclared cases bleed at the family default
CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT.gate: migratable with the approved default alone; a case declaration needs trusted provenance
CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT.meaning: a case may declare a verified bleed rate or severity; an approved GI-family default is the fallback when it does not
CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT.risk: the default silently governs every undeclared case, so its value matters as much as any case's; a severity-to-rate mapping is itself a faculty decision

CASE_REQUIRED.authoring: mandatory new field in every GI case before migration
CASE_REQUIRED.clinical: every case's haemorrhage is explicit; no case inherits a rate it was not authored for
CASE_REQUIRED.gate: fails closed for every case without the field
CASE_REQUIRED.meaning: every GI case must declare its own verified rate; no fallback
CASE_REQUIRED.risk: neither bank case states a rate today (melena since yesterday; three days and another episode), so both stay blocked until authored

FAMILY_ALLOWED_RANGE.authoring: the same new per-case field as CASE_OVERRIDES_FAMILY_DEFAULT, plus the range's bounds
FAMILY_ALLOWED_RANGE.clinical: brisk and slow bleeding can differ within approved limits
FAMILY_ALLOWED_RANGE.gate: fails closed without a verified case rate, unless the approval defines a fallback
FAMILY_ALLOWED_RANGE.meaning: the family approves a range as an authorization envelope, not as the source of the value: the rate is the case's verified one and must fall inside it
FAMILY_ALLOWED_RANGE.risk: without a case rate it runs only on an explicitly approved range fallback; otherwise it closes, as CASE_REQUIRED does for both bank cases today; both bounds are faculty decisions

FAMILY_FIXED_VALUE.clinical: every GI patient bleeds alike; a brisk and a slow bleed cannot be distinguished
FAMILY_FIXED_VALUE.gate: migratable with the approved value alone
FAMILY_FIXED_VALUE.meaning: one approved GI-family rate for every case; cases cannot override it
FAMILY_FIXED_VALUE.risk: one GI constant becomes universal truth for the family (the faculty already rejected treating the legacy literal so)
